CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

October 22, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN (Attended later in the meeting)
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: October 8, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the October 8, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board member Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  Audio Recording verified that Nora Hernandez did vote on this item #1.
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  601 South Meridian Ave, DRB-2024-00090

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 5’-9” high iron gate and three (3) window
  replacements on an existing single-family residence.
  •  Applicant: Yao Li
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following Conditions of Approval:

  1
   1. Provide an elevation keynote or general note on the plans that states all
  window sills are to be maintained in similar color, material, size, and style.
  2. Provide a horizontal grid/muntin to both sashes for the proposed windows,
  which are to be permanently applied to the exterior of the window glass to
  match the existing window grid layout.
  3. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Provide an elevation keynote or general note on the plans that states all
  window sills are to be maintained in similar color, material, size, and style, as
  well as providing current photos of the new windows.
  2. Provide a horizontal grid/muntin to both sashes for the proposed windows,
  which are to be permanently applied to the exterior of the window glass to
  match the existing window grid layout.
  3. Revise existing and proposed site plans to accurately identify the existing
  conditions of the side wall.
  4. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  929 South Eighth Street, DRB-2024-00092

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 3 ft. and 6 ft. high block wall and iron
  gate on an existing residential property.
  •  Applicant: Raymond Kwong
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to continue the application with the
  following considerations:
  1. The applicant should consider reducing the front yard wall height to be no more
  than 16” with appropriate wall cap and finishes that are consistent with the
  Craftsman style of the house.
  2. Revise front yard wall elevations to demonstrate any changes in wall height as
  the site slopes in grade, and show any tapering as needed.
  3. The Design Review Board is accepting of the proposed 6 ft. height wall as
  present.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  2
   Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 4:  2409 Poplar Boulevard, DRB-2024-00012

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 3 ft. high wood fence and sliding gate
  within the front yard setback, and 6 ft. high wood fence along the side and rear
  property lines of an existing single-family residential lot.
  •  Applicant: Hong Le
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to continue the application with the
  following considerations:
  1. The applicant shall reduce the front yard fence height to 3 ft. maximum
  measured from finish grade to comply with City’s zoning code, and update
  fence elevations as needed to demonstrate compliance.
  2. Revise front yard fence elevations to show any changes in fence height due to
  the sloped grade, and show any tapering as needed.
  3. Increase front yard fence transparency by removing every other vertical wood
  board to achieve a higher level of transparency / openness.
  4. The applicant shall emphasize the front yard fence post by exposing the post
  and adding a decorative post cap.
  5. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  3
 ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:04 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on November 12, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:04 P.M.
  •  The second was by Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
